title: Stylization as Geodesic Navigation on Diffusion Manifolds
abstract: arXiv:2611.14097v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Facial stylization asks for a delicate transformation: the image should look unmistakably artistic, yet the person should remain unmistakably the same. Existing training-free and instruction-driven methods often fail to expose such control, either drifting away from identity or producing only weak stylization. We introduce Stylus, a training-free framework that treats facial style transfer as navigation on the curved latent manifold of a pretrained diffusion model. Rather than interpolating in flat Euclidean space, \method refines the interpolated content--style point by lowering a ratio-weighted discrete geodesic energy under the pullback metric, made tractable by a rank-one power-iteration approximation of the Jacobian. This principle drives two complementary controls: content--style latent interpolation for smooth semantic fusion, and self-attention query optimization for spatially adaptive style injection. translated_title: 风格化即扩散流形上的测地线导航
translated_abstract: 面部风格化要求一种精细的变换：图像应看起来无疑具有艺术性，同时人物又应保持无疑是自己。现有的免训练方法和基于指令的方法往往无法提供这样的控制，要么偏离人物身份，要么只能产生较弱的艺术化效果。我们提出了Stylus，一个免训练框架，它将面部风格迁移视为在预训练扩散模型弯曲潜在流形上的导航过程。不同于在平坦欧几里得空间中进行插值，Stylus通过在回拉度量下最小化比率加权的离散测地线能量来精炼插值得到的内容-风格点，并借助雅可比矩阵的秩一幂迭代近似使该过程可计算。这一原理驱动了两种互补的控制方式：内容-风格潜在插值用于实现平滑的语义融合，自注意力查询优化用于实现空间自适应的风格注入。由此产生的双控制设计（原文此处截断）……
tldr: 提出免训练框架Stylus，将人脸风格化建模为在预训练扩散模型弯曲潜在流形上沿测地线导航的过程，通过内容-风格潜在插值与自注意力查询优化双控制，实现既具艺术风格又保持人物身份的风格迁移。
en_tdlr: Stylus is a training-free framework that formulates facial stylization as geodesic navigation on the curved latent manifold of a pretrained diffusion model, using content-style latent interpolation and self-attention query optimization to achieve artistic yet identity-preserving stylization.
